camp.title: Bulk e-mail
camp.lead: E-mail customers you pick from the CRM or paste in, and set how many e-mails go out an hour and a day. They are sent in small batches so the limits are never passed.
camp.none: No campaigns yet. Start a new one.
camp.name: Campaign name
camp.name_help: For you only; recipients do not see it.
camp.limits_sub: Covers every campaign together. Keep it within what your mail provider allows so sending is not blocked.
camp.limits_note: Platform-wide limit: {hour} an hour and {day} a day for all campaigns together; no campaign goes over it.
camp.start_at_help: Leave empty to start as soon as you press Start sending.
camp.subject: Subject
camp.body_help: Press Customer's name to put each customer's name in their e-mail, and Clinic's name for their clinic. Anyone without a name gets "Doctor". An unsubscribe link is added at the end of every e-mail.
camp.created: The campaign was created. Now choose who gets it.
camp.delete_confirm: Delete this campaign and its sending log?
camp.lead_draft: Choose the recipients and send yourself a test, then start sending.
camp.lead_sending: A batch goes out every minute within the limits. You can pause at any time.
camp.lead_paused: Sending is paused. You can change the message or add recipients, then resume.
camp.lead_done: The campaign went to every recipient.
camp.lead_cancelled: The campaign was cancelled; the rest will not be sent.
camp.start_confirm: This sends to {n} recipients, at most {hour} an hour and {day} a day. Start?
camp.cancel_confirm: Cancel this campaign? Those not reached yet will not get it.
camp.no_email: The platform e-mail is not set up, so nothing is sent.
camp.test_sub: Send it to yourself to see it before starting. It is not counted in the campaign.
camp.test_sent: A test e-mail was sent to {to}.
camp.choose_sub: CRM contacts with an e-mail (anyone who unsubscribed is not shown), or paste addresses.
camp.search_ph: Search name, clinic, e-mail or city
camp.no_people: No contacts with an e-mail match.
camp.paste_help: One address per line, optionally followed by a comma and the name.
camp.added: {added} recipients added ({skipped} skipped: already in or unsubscribed).
camp.clear_confirm: Remove every recipient not sent yet?
camp.recipients_sub: Failed first, then waiting, then sent.
camp.foot_text: You received this e-mail from {brand}. Don't want more?
camp.unsub_done: Done. No more promotional e-mails will go to {email}.
